title: Approval of individual three (3)-year Contracts with [i] Anderson & Kreiger LLP, [ii] Burke Williams & Sorensen LLP, [iii] Remy Moose Manley LLP, [iv] Kaplan Kirsch LLP, [v] Kronick Moskovitz Tiedeman
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of individual three (3)-year Contracts with [i] Anderson & Kreiger LLP, [ii] Burke Williams & Sorensen LLP, [iii] Remy Moose Manley LLP, [iv] Kaplan Kirsch LLP, [v] Kronick Moskovitz Tiedemann & Girard, [vi] Demetriou Del Guercio Springer & Francis LLP, and [vii] Meyers Nave: Covering provision of legal advice and representation to the City Attorney’s Office and Los Angeles World Airports in connection with the California Environmental Quality Act, National Environmental Policy Act, environmental issues and water law, for costs not to exceed $300,000, $300,000, $300,000, $750,000, $750,000, $875,000, and 875,000, respectively (Brian Ostler)
summary: Approval of individual three (3)-year Contracts with [i] Anderson & Kreiger LLP, [ii] Burke Williams & Sorensen LLP, [iii] Remy Moose Manley LLP.
